title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: Income support for eligible landholding farmer families through direct bank transfers.
eligibility: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land in their names are considered, subject to scheme exclusions. Higher-income exclusions include income-tax payers and specified government employees. The consulted national source is not limited to Punjab; it does not establish any particular person's eligibility.
required_documents_json: ["Aadhaar information and e-KYC", "Bank account details including IFSC", "Land-ownership records", "Self-declaration concerning exclusion criteria"]

title: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship Scheme (NMMSS)
description: Scholarships to help selected students from economically weaker families continue secondary education.
eligibility: Selected Class IX students must qualify through the State/UT examination. Covered schools are State Government, government-aided and local-body schools. Parental annual income must not exceed Rs. 3.50 lakh. Class VII marks for the selection test are at least 55%, with a five-percentage-point relaxation for SC/ST students.

title: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
description: Renewable annual personal accident insurance covering specified accidental death or disability.
eligibility: Individual account holders aged 18 to 70 at participating banks or post offices may join through one account. Enrolment requires consent to premium auto-debit. Scheme terms determine covered losses; account ownership and age alone do not confirm that insurance is active.

title: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
description: Annually renewable term life insurance offered through participating bank and post-office accounts.
eligibility: Individual account holders aged 18 to 50 may enrol through one participating bank or post-office account with auto-debit consent. Renewal can continue to age 55 subject to scheme terms. A 30-day lien applies to non-accidental deaths for new entrants and re-entrants.

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: Contributory retirement pension scheme with pension options linked to contributions.
eligibility: The August 2024 Finance Ministry parliamentary answer describes Indian citizens aged 18 to 40 with a savings bank or post-office account. Income-tax payers are not eligible to join from October 1, 2022. This is a national scheme, not a Punjab-only pension.

title: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
description: Government small-savings account for the future education and other permitted needs of a girl child.
eligibility: A parent or legal guardian may open an account for an Indian girl child before she reaches age 10. Only one account is permitted per girl, normally for up to two girls in a family, with specified twin/triplet exceptions. This account is not an automatic scholarship entitlement.

title: PM Vishwakarma
description: Support for traditional artisans through recognition, training, toolkits, credit and marketing assistance.
eligibility: Self-employed artisans aged at least 18 working with hands and tools in one of 18 notified family-based trades in the unorganised sector may be considered. Registration is limited to one family member; government employees and their family members are excluded. Similar government credit received in the previous five years can restrict eligibility, with specified fully repaid MUDRA/SVANidhi exceptions.

title: Punjab Ashirwad Scheme
description: Punjab marriage assistance scheme for specified disadvantaged families.
eligibility: The district government source states that the girl must be at least 18 and her parents or guardians must have Punjab domicile. It lists Scheduled Castes, Christian girls, Backward Classes, economically weaker families and specified widow/remarriage categories. Living in another state alone does not establish the required Punjab domicile.
